title: Phase gauge and probe schedule lab
content:
Purpose:
- Quick personal lab notebook to capture a gentle phased rollout (not the canonical playbook), focusing on probe scheduling, warmup priming, and pragmatic gating for model/runtime flips.

High level plan (summary):
1) Warmup cohort (0.5%): static key tenants + synthetic probes for 30m. Verify KV cache warms and perf baseline within 10% of expected p50/p95.
2) Drift probes + telemetry (2% total): mix of real low-risk clients + synthetic edge queries (diversity across seq lengths). Run for 1h, collect quality regression metrics and token-cost deltas.
3) Controlled expansion (2% -> 10% -> 25% over 6h windows) with hold checks at each gate.
4) Full rollout after stability window and no critical regressions for 3 consecutive gates.

Telemetry gating matrix (quick):
- p50 latency: +/− 15% allowed; p95: hard stop if > +25%
- error rate (500/502/timeout): stop if > 0.75% absolute or 3x baseline
- encoding/decoding token spikes: alert if > 20% token count change per request cohort
- semantic quality (eval set): fail gate if BLEU/ROUGE-ish surrogate drops > 3 points or hallucination counters rise > 8 per 10k requests

Probe schedule (synthetic):
- 00:00 start warmup probes (fixed corpus x50, seq mix short/long)
- 00:30 validate cache priming metrics
- 01:00 start drift probes (live-sampled but scrubbed) + compare outputs to baseline model on 200 prompts
- Hold gates every 60–90m during expansion windows

Commands / quick run snippets (local orchestrator):
- kick off warmup: ./tools/warmup-run --cohort 0.5 --corpus ./synthetic/warmup-50.txt --duration 30m
- start probe compare: python tools/probe_compare.py --baseline s1 --candidate s2 --sample 200 --report /tmp/probe-report.json
- bump fraction (example): ./deploy/traffic-router set-fraction --route api/text-gen --fraction 0.10 --reason "phase-gauge-2->10"

Rollback triggers (fast kills):
- any single region crossing p95 stop threshold or sustained error rate > 1% for 10m -> immediate rollback to previous candidate and notify on-call.
- regression on semantic eval set > 5% -> pin and roll back, open ticket.

Pinning notes (manual pin flow):
- Use admin console: Models > candidate > Pin to release: select previous model version hash, annotate reason, set "pinned_until" for 24h to allow analysis.
- If using SDK toggles per-tenant: flip to pinned model via tenant override API: POST /admin/tenants/<id>/model-override {"model":"v1234-pinned"}

Open questions / things to validate:
- How reproducible are our synthetic probes across hardware types (A100 vs H100)? capture per-host variance.
- Can batching heuristics cause silent token count inflation during warmup? instrument kernel-level stats.
- Confirm tracing ties request-id -> candidate-version in logs for easier RCA.

Todo (personal):
- [ ] Add a small example dataset that exercises identity and safety edge cases (deadline 2024-11-10)
- [ ] Link PR for automated gate runner: github PR -> add heartbeat and rollback automation
- [ ] Run a dry-run with shadow traffic for 2h next Tuesday in eu-west1

Slack crumbs / refs: #release-alpha thread (seeded by Priya), shared sheet: /sheets/driveid-priming-schedule (TODO paste), related Confluence: release-gating-heuristics.

Notes to self (short):
- Keep cohorts intentionally boring at first (low variance clients + synthetic probes).
- Make the first two holds long enough to capture warmup (not just transit latency).
- When in doubt, pin and inspect traces — failures compound quickly at scale.

If this works we can formalize into a short runbook and hand it to on-call for one-click rollback automation.
